skill.summary: Analyzes live local data from 10 sources to identify, score, and strategize your best international markets with validated demand, competition gaps, and lead...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: comprehensive international market expansion analysis and strategy tool.

- Simultaneously deploys 10 Apify scrapers across local platforms (Google, Amazon, Reddit, LinkedIn, news, Trustpilot, Google Trends, e-commerce, Twitter, government data).
- Builds a live-data international market intelligence report for any country—demand, competition, pricing, culture, regulation.
- Scores each country across 6 market-entry dimensions.
- Identifies top local competitors and their weaknesses.
- Generates a localized go-to-market strategy with actionable recommendations.
- Sets up automated international lead capture using GetResponse.
